Berry & Granola Smoothie Bowl
By: Justina Elumeze
Published: Thursday, April 7, 2016 - 5:02am

Ingredients




5 very ripe, frozen bananas
1/4 cup almond milk
Handfull of strawberries, chopped
Handful of blueberries
Handful of coconut flakes
Small handful of chia seeds
Handful of Granola
Few drops of vanilla extract & honey, if desired

Preparation

1 Place the milk, chia seeds, vanilla essence, honey and bananas in a blender and blend till smmoth. 2 Place in a bowl and sprinkle the remaining ingredients on top. 3 Thats's it!

About

An ideal healthy breakfast for those on the go. This berry and granola smoothie is effective in packing a nutrient filled punch.
